start saves/ladder6_postgame.sav
include ../../scripts/continue.txt
fastbattles off
pinrng                     # same personalities, genders and natures on every ROM

ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST, 100, gender=MON_MALE; createmon 0, 1, SPECIES_CENTISKORCH, 100, gender=MON_MALE; createmon 0, 2, SPECIES_IRON_JUGULIS, 100; createmon 0, 3, SPECIES_DARUMAKA_GALAR, 100, gender=MON_MALE; createmon 0, 4, SPECIES_JANGMO_O, 100, gender=MON_MALE; createmon 0, 5, SPECIES_IRON_BUNDLE, 100; special CalculatePlayerPartyCount; end
include _sn_party_open.txt
snap W2_party
include _sn_party_to_summary.txt
snap W2_s0_info
sumkey DOWN
snap W2_s1_info
sumkey DOWN
snap W2_s2_info
sumkey DOWN
snap W2_s3_info
sumkey DOWN
snap W2_s4_info
sumkey DOWN
snap W2_s5_info
include ../../scripts/r2_summary_info_page_variants/_sum_close.txt
include _sn_pc_deposit.txt
snap W2_pc_s0
pcgoto party 1
waitquiet
snap W2_pc_s1
pcgoto party 2
waitquiet
snap W2_pc_s2
pcgoto party 3
waitquiet
snap W2_pc_s3
pcgoto party 4
waitquiet
snap W2_pc_s4
pcgoto party 5
waitquiet
snap W2_pc_s5
include _sn_pc_close.txt
ev .set ROM_SIZE, 0; createmon 0, 0, SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST, 100, gender=MON_MALE; end
evstart .set ROM_SIZE, 0; setwildbattle SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST, 5; createmon 1, 0, SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST, 5, gender=MON_MALE; dowildbattle; end
waitbattle
bwalk W2_0_BRAMBLEGHAST_bt input:HandleInputChooseAction
snap W2_0_BRAMBLEGHAST_bt_action
baction RUN
bwalk W2_0_BRAMBLEGHAST_run free
